acceptanceCriteria: make dogfood-finish (or dogfood-change prepare) runs spec-requirements-check when the diff touches docs/specs/** and refuses with the make spec-requirements recovery
Regression test: a fixture spec edit without regeneration is refused before bind
body: Observed 2026-10-18 on PR #1097 (V1-1710): review-fix commit 6ea521b95 edited docs/specs/shared-path-change-policy-v0.md without regenerating docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv. make dogfood-finish bound and sealed it, the lane pushed, and CI doc-gates spec-requirements-check failed (line 3487 stale), costing a CI round and a repair lane. Expected: a stale generated requirements index is refused locally before bind/seal.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1393); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 0538b841d8210c53e2cf70eb8176b44da8edd3c08e7bd9f91a6ffa0c9a8062e0.

title: dogfood bind/seal accepts a spec edit whose REQUIREMENTS.tsv was not regenerated; stale index first caught in CI
